items.name: fix_a
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular, witty long-form history YouTube documentary about India. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: relaxed and conversational, curious, lightly funny, with a short comic pause before each punchline and before chapter turns. Chars voices funny cartoon characters (a cheeky time-traveller, city inspectors, brick-makers, engineers, kings, emperors, sultans, merchants, soldiers): short, punchy, expressive, following the bracketed style tags. Pronounce Indian names and places naturally, the way an Indian speaker would. IMPORTANT: keep the Narrator in the same full, warm, projected speaking voice and volume on every line, exactly like a normal documentary read. Never whisper, never drop into a hushed, breathy or intimate tone, even on dramatic or mysterious lines.
lines: Because if you look closely, India keeps living the same story.
First, someone stitches the land together. Then it shines, the richest place on Earth. Then it shatters into pieces. Outsiders march in to take it...
...and then something strange happens. India absorbs them. The invaders end up eating its food, speaking its languages, and building its monuments.
Stitch. Shine. Shatter. Absorb. Again and again.
So how did one land become the richest place in the world, lose it all, and start climbing back?
[winding his watch] Hold on to something.
Let's go back to the very beginning.
